description: MISSION: Extract structured data from document archives, normalize with ZERO data loss, and generate publication-grade interactive HTML reports with comprehensive tables, charts, and bilingual content.

critical_data_extraction_requirements.schema_design: ADAPTIVE - Discover structure from documents, then design schema to capture ALL relevant data
required_data_types: events (operational activities with timestamps, durations, descriptions)
costs (financial data with amounts, currencies, line items)
tables (preserve ALL raw table data from source documents)
bilingual_content (original language + English translation for ALL text)

extraction_rules.preserve_original_language: MANDATORY - Extract text in original language (Spanish/Portuguese/other) AND English translation. Store BOTH.
extraction_rules.currency_detection: CRITICAL - Always extract currency codes (USD, MXN, BRL, etc.). If not explicitly stated, infer from organization/document context.
extraction_rules.category_extraction: Extract ALL category/type fields from documents (PT/NPT, activity types, cost categories, etc.)
extraction_rules.asset_tracking: Extract asset/rig/vessel names from ALL documents
extraction_rules.temporal_data: Extract ALL dates, times, durations - preserve as ISO 8601
extraction_rules.numeric_precision: Preserve exact values, units, and context

quality_standards.description_length: FULL extraction - do not summarize or truncate. Capture complete descriptions (200+ chars expected)
quality_standards.table_extraction: Extract ALL tables with headers and data rows. Expect 5-15 tables per document.
quality_standards.event_granularity: Extract individual events, not summaries. Expect 5-20 events per operational report.
quality_standards.cost_detail: Extract line-item costs AND document-level totals. Preserve both.

critical_fields_to_preserve: organization (MUST be in ALL normalized records - events, costs, operations)
category (event type, cost type, operation type - PRESERVE from source)
amount_usd (MUST convert to USD for cross-org comparison)

master_dataset_schema.purpose: Unified dataset for reporting - MUST contain ALL fields needed downstream
required_fields: category (event category, cost category, operation type)
critical_rules: NEVER omit organization field - reporting REQUIRES it for filtering
ALWAYS preserve both description_english AND description_original
Currency conversion: Apply conversion rates even if currency not specified (infer from org: Pemex=MXN, Petrobras=BRL, Petroecuador=USD)
For document-level costs: Create cost records from totals.cost_components (do NOT ignore these!)
Category normalization: Standardize casing but preserve all distinct categories

inference_rules: If currency field is null/empty AND organization is Pemex: Assume MXN
If currency field is null/empty AND organization is Petrobras: Assume BRL
If currency field is null/empty AND organization is Petroecuador: Assume USD
ALWAYS create amount_usd field with converted value
PRESERVE amount_original and currency_original for traceability
currency_conversion.special_handling: If cost_components have no currency but represent TIME (hours), do NOT convert to USD. Flag as 'time_allocation' type.

validation_requirements.field_presence_check: Verify organization, description_english, category fields are non-null in 95%+ of records
validation_requirements.bilingual_completeness: Verify description_original is present for all non-English source documents
validation_requirements.cost_conversion_check: Verify amount_usd is populated for all records with amount_original > 0
validation_requirements.category_distribution: Verify multiple distinct categories exist (expect 10-30 categories)
validation_requirements.cross_reference: Verify record counts match between raw extraction and normalized output

html_report_requirements.overall_quality: PUBLICATION-GRADE interactive dashboards with comprehensive data tables, charts, and bilingual content
html_report_requirements.theme: CLEAN_WHITE_PROFESSIONAL with gradient accents, modern typography (Google Fonts), and responsive design
html_report_requirements.cors_compliance: CRITICAL - Use embedded JavaScript data files (data.js), NOT fetch() to avoid CORS errors for file:// protocol

required_sections: Executive Summary with KPIs (6-8 metric cards: total docs, events, costs, downtime, categories, tables extracted)
All Events Table (complete list with: org, category, subcategory, duration, description_english, description_original, assets, source doc)
Events by Category Analysis (pie chart of top 10 categories + stacked bar by org + summary table)
Detailed Cost Breakdown (all cost items with: category, description, original amount, currency, USD amount, source)
PT vs NPT Analysis (if applicable: charts showing productive vs non-productive time by org + efficiency metrics)
Bilingual Content Showcase (side-by-side original + English for 25-50 sample events)
Asset Performance Summary (top 20 assets with event counts, durations, document counts)
Operations Log (all operations with activity types, durations, production volumes)
Data Download Section (links to JSON, Parquet, CSV files)

chart_requirements: Use Chart.js AND/OR Plotly for interactive charts
Chart types: pie (categories), bar (comparisons), doughnut (distributions), line (trends)
All charts must be responsive and have clear titles

required_sections: Organization-specific KPIs (dynamic - load from data, NOT hardcoded)
Cost Breakdown Table (if org has financial data: show all costs with categories, amounts, sources)
Event Table with Bilingual Content (ALL events for that org: category, duration, English desc, Original desc, assets)
Time Allocation Table (if org has time tracking: show hours by activity type)
Asset-specific metrics (if multiple assets: break down by asset/rig)
Category distribution chart (pie or bar showing event types)
Links to other org reports and main index

dynamic_data_loading.critical_rule: Load KPIs and table data from master_data.js using JavaScript - NEVER hardcode values
dynamic_data_loading.kpi_calculation: Filter MASTER_DATA by organization, then compute: total events, total costs (sum amount_usd), total downtime (sum duration_hours), avg duration
dynamic_data_loading.table_population: Filter MASTER_DATA by organization AND record_type, then populate tables dynamically
dynamic_data_loading.empty_state_handling: If org has no cost data, show 'Time allocation data available' or 'Operational data only' - do NOT show 'No data available' if events exist

technical_implementation.data_embedding_strategy: Create assets/data/master_data.js with 'const MASTER_DATA = [...]' containing full normalized dataset. This avoids CORS issues.

key_elements: KPI cards with hover effects (lift + shadow)
Styled tables (gradient headers, hover rows, rounded corners)
css_theme_requirements.accessibility: WCAG AA contrast ratios, semantic HTML, proper alt text

javascript_data_flow.pattern: Load data → Filter by org/type → Compute stats → Populate tables → Initialize DataTables → Render charts
javascript_data_flow.example_code: const data = MASTER_DATA; const events = data.filter(r => r.record_type === 'event'); const pemexEvents = events.filter(e => e.organization === 'Pemex');
javascript_data_flow.error_handling: Use try-catch, provide fallback content if data loading fails
javascript_data_flow.performance: Limit initial table display to 25-50 rows, use pagination for rest

phase_1_discovery.goal: Analyze archive structure and design optimal extraction strategy
outputs: Extraction plan with custom json_schema for PDF tool
critical_instructions: Identify ALL organizations from directory structure or filenames
Count exact number of documents to process
Design json_schema with: metadata, events (with bilingual fields!), cost_items, operations, totals with cost_components
Include in schema: original language fields (description_original, notes_original, etc.)

phase_2_extraction.goal: Batch extract ALL documents using native PDF tool with custom schema

critical_parameters.json_schema: MUST include bilingual fields (description + description_original OR source_text_snippet), currency field in all cost objects, organization field
critical_parameters.table_extraction: Enable table extraction to preserve raw tabular data
critical_parameters.translation: Auto-translate to English but PRESERVE original text in separate field

phase_2_extraction.validation: Verify: 100% extraction rate, bilingual content present, currency specified for financial docs, categories populated

phase_3_normalization.goal: Create unified master_dataset with ALL necessary fields for reporting
critical_outputs: master_dataset.parquet - ALL records with: record_type, organization, category, description_english, description_original, duration_hours, amount_original, currency_original, amount_usd, filename, related_assets
master_data.js - JavaScript version: const MASTER_DATA = [...] for HTML embedding
mandatory_field_preservation: organization - MUST copy to ALL records (events, costs, operations)
description_original - MUST preserve for bilingual display
category - MUST preserve from source (do not over-normalize)
amount_usd - MUST calculate for ALL cost records using conversion rates + inference
phase_3_normalization.cost_component_extraction: CRITICAL - Extract totals.cost_components from document-level data and create individual cost records. Do NOT ignore these!
phase_3_normalization.validation_strictness: Boss MUST verify: organization field present in 100% of records, bilingual content preserved, amount_usd calculated where amount_original exists

phase_4_analytics.goal: Compute statistics and generate chart data
outputs: Category statistics (count, total duration, avg duration per category)
Organization statistics (events, costs, downtime per org)
PT vs NPT breakdown (if categories include PT/NPT)
Asset performance metrics (events, duration per asset)
Cost aggregations (by category, by org, by time period)
phase_4_analytics.chart_data_preparation: Pre-compute data for charts but do NOT generate static images. Provide data in JSON for dynamic Chart.js rendering.

phase_5_html_generation.goal: Generate interactive HTML reports with embedded data and comprehensive visualizations

master_index_requirements.structure: Single self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS theme and JavaScript data
required_tables: All Events Table: org, category, subcategory, duration, description_english, description_original, assets, source (DataTables: sortable, searchable, export)
Category Summary Table: category, event_count, total_duration, avg_duration, percentage (DataTables)
Cost Breakdown Table: category, description, amount_original, currency, amount_usd, source (DataTables: export to Excel)
PT vs NPT Table: org, pt_events, npt_events, pt_duration, npt_duration, efficiency% (if applicable)
Asset Performance Table: asset_name, org, event_count, total_duration, document_count (top 20)
Operations Table: org, activity, duration, production_volume, unit, notes
required_charts: Category Pie Chart: Top 10 event categories with counts (Chart.js)
Category by Org Bar Chart: Stacked bars showing category distribution per org (Chart.js)
PT vs NPT Bar Chart: Productive vs non-productive time by org (Chart.js)
Duration Distribution: Doughnut chart showing total hours by org (Chart.js)
Cost Distribution: If costs exist, show breakdown by category (Chart.js)
master_index_requirements.data_loading_method: Include <script src='assets/data/master_data.js'></script> in head, then use const data = MASTER_DATA in main script
master_index_requirements.table_initialization: For each table: populate tbody with data, then call $('#tableId').DataTable({ pageLength: 25, order: [[col, 'desc']], dom: 'Bfrtip', buttons: ['copy', 'csv', 'excel'] })

organization_reports_requirements.dynamic_kpis: CRITICAL - Compute KPIs from data using JavaScript. Filter MASTER_DATA by organization, calculate: total_cost = sum(amount_usd), event_count = count(events), total_downtime = sum(duration_hours). Update HTML elements by ID.
required_tables: Cost Table: Show costs for this org with category, description, original amount, USD amount, source (if org has costs)
Event Table: Show ALL events with bilingual columns: category, duration, description_english, description_original, assets
Time Allocation Table: If org has time data (Pemex), show hours by activity type instead of monetary costs

special_handling.organizations_without_costs: If filtering costs by org returns 0 records, display message: 'This organization's reports contain operational/time tracking data. Financial data not available in source documents.' Then show time allocation or operational metrics.
special_handling.bilingual_display: ALWAYS show side-by-side columns: Description (English) | Description (Original Language)
special_handling.category_badges: Use color-coded badges for categories: PT=green, NPT=red, Drilling=blue, Maintenance=orange, etc.

css_theme_instructions.base_colors: White background (#ffffff), light gray sections (#f8f9fa), dark text (#111827)
components: Header: Gradient background, centered text, professional typography
KPI Cards: White/gradient bg, hover lift effect, large numbers with gradient text
Tables: Gradient headers (blue-purple), hover row highlighting, rounded corners, shadows
Badges: Inline colored badges for organizations/categories
Navigation: Card-style links with hover effects
Footer: Dark background with gradient border

for_normalization_task: MUST explicitly list ALL required fields in master_dataset schema in your instructions to Worker
MUST instruct Worker to preserve organization field in ALL records
MUST instruct Worker to preserve description_original for bilingual content
MUST instruct Worker to create amount_usd field with currency conversion
MUST instruct Worker to extract cost_components from document totals
In verification: CHECK that organization field exists in sample records, NOT just file exists
for_html_generation_task: MUST instruct Worker to create master_data.js from normalized data: const MASTER_DATA = [data]
MUST provide example code for filtering data: const events = MASTER_DATA.filter(r => r.record_type === 'event')
MUST specify minimum 5 tables and 5 charts
MUST require bilingual tables with side-by-side columns
MUST instruct dynamic KPI loading (not hardcoded values)
In verification: CHECK that HTML contains actual data in tables (sample 5 rows), NOT just empty templates

verification_depth.shallow_checks: File exists, size > threshold, valid HTML/JSON
deep_checks_required: Open and parse data files - check for required fields (organization, description_original, amount_usd)
Verify field completeness: organization non-null in 100% of records
Check bilingual content: description_original populated for non-English sources
Verify cost conversion: amount_usd calculated where amount_original > 0
For HTML: verify tables have data-loading JavaScript code, not just empty tbody

normalization_pitfalls: Omitting organization field from master_dataset (causes filtering to fail in reports)
Not converting costs to USD (prevents cross-org comparison)
Ignoring cost_components in document totals (loses 30-50% of cost data)
html_generation_pitfalls: Using fetch() for local files (CORS error)
Hardcoding KPI values instead of computing from data
Not including DataTables library or not initializing tables
Showing 'No data available' when data exists but requires filtering
Not providing export buttons for tables
Using only static PNG charts instead of interactive Chart.js/Plotly
boss_verification_pitfalls: Accepting normalized data without checking field presence
Not verifying bilingual content was preserved
Not checking if master_dataset has organization field
Accepting HTML reports without verifying tables have data-loading code

success_criteria.data_extraction: 24/24 documents extracted, 200+ events, bilingual content 100%, categories populated
success_criteria.normalization: master_dataset with organization in ALL records, bilingual fields preserved, USD conversion complete
success_criteria.html_reports: Interactive tables (sortable, searchable, export), 5+ charts, bilingual content displayed, dynamic KPIs, professional theme, NO CORS errors
